content.title: Charles Schwab to acquire Forge in $660M deal: CEO explains why
content.description:
Charles Schwab (SCHW) CEO Rick Wurster joins Market Catalysts with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the company's acquisition of Forge (FRGE) and to explain why Charles Schwab is expanding its private market offerings for investors.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Schwab notches a $660 million deal agreement with private asset firm Forge Global Holdings
content.summary: Charles Schwab said Thursday that it's buying publicly traded investing platform Forge Global Holdings, which acts as a marketplace for pre-IPO companies, for $660 million.
